channel.title: CorX Labs — releases and notes
channel.description: Model releases and technical write-ups from CorX Labs, an independent AI research lab in Jamaica.

item.title: CorX3.8-27B — Jamaica's first large open-weight LLM
item.dc:creator: Nathan
item.description:
CorX3.8-27B is a 27-billion-parameter Jamaican Patois-speaking assistant, third in the CorX line after CorX1.5 and TriStream. It speaks Patois by default and switches to standard English on request, answers directly, holds boundaries, and carries everyday Jamaican cultural reference — while keeping the general reasoning, code and maths of its base model.

It is a fine-tune of the open-weight Qwen3.8-27B base (Apache 2.0), fully merged and standalone. It runs in 4-bit on a single ~24GB GPU. For factual questions, CorX Labs ships a retrieval layer that grounds answers on real Jamaican sources. Repository: Sigmandndnns/CorX3.8-27B.

item.title: TriStream-SVS — singing voice synthesis, factored by design
item.dc:creator: Nathan
item.description:
TriStream-SVS is a 321.8M parameter singing voice synthesis model that builds the source-filter theory of human voice production into its architecture as a hard constraint: three parallel encoder streams for pitch, timbre and breath texture, combined only in a late fusion trunk. Zero-shot voice cloning via a contrastive speaker encoder, an adversarial singer head with gradient reversal as an anti-memorisation mechanism, and a rectified flow-matching decoder that generates in roughly 32 sampling steps.

Actively in training — no stable release checkpoint yet. Repository: Sigmandndnns/TriStream-SVS-300M.

item.title: 3 Billion Tokens on One GPU: How CorX1.5 Was Trained
item.dc:creator: Nathan
item.description: Everyone asks how 3 billion training tokens fit on a single GPU. They never had to. A technical breakdown of what actually has to fit in VRAM for a 158M-parameter model, the 6 GB memory-mapped token file the dataset really lives in, sequence packing, gradient accumulation, and why the whole pretraining run is only about 5,700 optimiser steps.

item.title: Announcement: CorX Labs releases CorX1.5
item.dc:creator: CorX Labs
item.description: CorX Labs, an independent AI research lab in Jamaica, has released CorX1.5 — a 158-million-parameter language model designed and trained entirely from scratch by a single developer on a single GPU, under the Apache 2.0 licence.

item.title: CorX1.5 — a 158M parameter language model built from scratch
item.dc:creator: Nathan
item.description:
CorX1.5 is an open-source language model with roughly 158 million parameters, built entirely from scratch by a single developer in Jamaica. It is a custom decoder-only transformer using RoPE positional encoding, SwiGLU feed-forward layers and RMSNorm, with learned role embeddings, assistant-only loss masking, 10 layers, a 1,024-token context window and a 32,768-token custom BPE vocabulary.

Trained in three stages — pretraining on ~3B tokens across 25 open datasets, distillation from a larger teacher model, then reasoning training with step-by-step <think> blocks. Released under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face.
